title: Braun DNA
description: Braun DNA — Dieter Rams functionalism: warm gray, black text, signal-orange dot — fonts via <link> (see docs), full app-variable bridge (shadcn + sidebar + charts + font/shadow scales). Wrap your app root in class "theme-braun-dna".
